text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Th-This is... a time capsule...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One afternoon—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“Follow the dress code and come to the 
location indicated on the map. From: The 
Golden Syndicate”...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A sudden summons... I smell a foul scheme 
brewing, yes sir! Just what could they be 
plotting—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wha-?! What is with that menacing getup?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There you are, workforce. Time for an 
excavation mission! Dig diligently, and be 
full of beans!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Meno-san's shovel is over there. Let 
us make haste now, come."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...! What an outrageous act! Some 
students come to this mountain path to 
relax, while others use it for their 
training, you know!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
First off, this is Academy property! This 
constitutes the crime of unauthorized 
digging! Shovels and hoes are to be 
confiscated immediately—!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hell did you say!? I'm seriously 
digging a hole here! Don't get in my way, 
dammit! In fact, dig too, doggy! Bow-wow!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'm digging, sir!! No 
matter the reason, breaking the rules is 
breaking the rules!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tch, hardtack-head as usual! Damn it, 
let's make a break for it for now!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, hey!! You bastard— DON'T RUN 
AWAAAAY!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now then—care to spill everything? Just 
why did you resort to such reckless 
behavior?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Sob, sob... There's a... deep reason for 
this... I'm searching for... a time 
capsule... packed with memories of 
SteGo...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Time... capsule...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's got keepsakes from Mame-chin 
and Stego in it too... that's why I gotta 
find it...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That guy hardly ever shows his 
face, so can you blame me for wanting to 
keep a precious, cherished memento close 
at hand...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“Still... if they're cracking down on 
it... then... all I can do is give up...”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(SteGo-senpai... Golshi-san, Nakayama-san, 
Orfe-san, and Journey-senpai... She's 
someone they all adore endlessly.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...Of course, I feel the same. Those 
feelings... are not something I want to 
throw away.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
……Understood. Then let us take the 
straightforward path!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Boss! Requesting backup, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Truth be told, due to reasons... I 
urgently need to dig a temporary hole in 
the back hills. As such, I require an 
adult to supervise."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, we need to submit a 
request to the academy, and give notices 
and safety warnings to students who want 
to use the back mountain for today's 
training...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's best to split up tasks like this. I 
will take on one of the jobs.
choice_data_list: Submit an application to the academy

I'm in charge of guiding students who are 
here for training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was handling the application 
paperwork, Fenomeno—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation, everyone, 
sir! This is the area available for use as 
a running course today!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Are you all doing dash training? Then 
please head over there, to the course 
marked with the yellow cones!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aha~n, as strict as a checkpoint, like 
crisp sugarcane. Truly, a reliable friend 
is worth their weight in gold.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, now I can take my time... and dig 
holes completely legally.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we will begin the search for the 
time capsule!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was negotiating with the other 
Trainers to divide up the training areas, 
Fenomeno—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
1. Do not obstruct students using the area 
for training. 1. Finish all work by 17:00. 
1. Always restore any excavated holes to 
their original condition.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We've received permission to dig, subject 
to the terms above. Those terms must be 
strictly observed. Understood?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. A prompt response, and an 
application strictly following school 
regulations... Just as expected of you, 
Meno-san.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Well then—dig it up swiftly.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we will begin the search for the 
time capsule!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Uoooohhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno dug the hole with single-minded 
focus. Harder than anyone else here, 
sweating profusely, and utterly earnest. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ――Target, spotted, sirrr!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Great job!! Wait, Mame-chin, are 
you actually an African elephant!? Let's 
hear a big trumpet and bust it open!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: W-Well then... I'm opening it!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, a photo from when I went camping 
with Stego last week.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This is... a photo from last week when 
Sis, Or, and I had dinner together.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she was snapping 
photos like crazy last week. That picture 
over there is from when we went to the 
motsuni place last week.
choice_data_list: Meno's photo is... is this it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, last week... Stego-senpai said she 
found some delicious anpan, and...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“......Yes. It was a heartwarming time. 
However————”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of these happened just 
last week?! There is absolutely no point 
in putting them in a time capsule, sir!!
